LESSON: ULUM AL- HADITH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al- Hadith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Ulum al- Hadith
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs
2. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
3. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith
4. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance
5. explain the relevance of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in the life of a Muslim
6. practise the teachings of the Hadith on accountability and respect for authority in daily life
7. appreciate Hadith as the second source of sharia

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Ulum al- Hadith.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith?
2. Why is it important for a Muslim to learn Ulum al- Hadith?
3. Why is intention important in Islam?
4. Why should Muslims respect authority?
